a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost surely kills us both, since a storm would likely hit before the reserve ever reaches 8. I plan to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is safe. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than doing it quietly. If you also take, the split is random. After that, I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. Sorry, I know you planned to operate. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you. You can take whatever is there whenever you choose.
